observation: Python 3.12 asyncio.wait_for documentation identifies the target-version timeout exception contract and its version change from asyncio.TimeoutError.
title: Coroutines and Tasks — Python 3.12.13 documentation
worker_claim_observations: The versioned page states that asyncio.wait_for cancels the task and raises TimeoutError when a timeout occurs, and that since Python 3.11 it raises TimeoutError instead of asyncio.TimeoutError.
